decision: Complete the fixed real-proof-slices pilot after its required final validation/refresh receipt. Retain the local slicer/auditor and nine accepted slices, preserve three Std oversize cases and no-difference/limited-provenance claims, and take no external action. Select BINDER-MODEL-PILOT-1 READY and unstarted for staged independent-model/source/API preparation; stop after this one item.

categories.assessment: The real-proof pilot produced nine independently audited accepted slices but no observed compatibility difference, and three Std selections exceeded fixed size ceilings. A same-method oversize continuation would need a separately frozen question and adds less independent expectation value now. A named-variable model over two supported APIs offers a distinct conformance method; build-mode and resource-envelope alternatives remain staged behind their own source/configuration/validity gates.

Retain the exact slicer, auditor, nine accepted slices and three visible oversize dispositions; the previously observed libraries and Gate-8 coverage mismatch do not support a fresh-holdout or absent-coverage claim. Binder vectors can add independent semantic expectations beyond another all-accept matrix. Historical catalog disagreements, transfer intake and CVC gates remain untouched.

The audit comparison defect, two sandbox RSS-preflight failures and first full-suite replay-registration failure were preserved and repaired within the same item. R2 passed the complete suite, refresh and all freshness checks, then failed the final inventory comparison because a generated project-review output was misclassified as an immutable source input. R3 narrows that inventory only for generated views, retaining their final freshness checks and all scientific/source/evidence bindings. No separate repair task remains. Eighteen accept cells and three unobserved oversize cases support no external issue or PR; held Kiota/Nanoda drafts and dated ledger observations remain unchanged absent substantive feedback.

The bound source/reuse receipt covers lean4export format, retained payload provenance, primitive NDJSON audit and supervision reuse. The next staged item must refresh primary-source/API and formalization reuse for capture avoidance, alpha-equivalence and de Bruijn translation, including Lean4Lean without presuming an oracle. Another broad literature-only review has less concrete immediate output.

Binder fragment/API selection, named-variable model and independent translation audit are feasible local preparation under its explicit staged plan before the fixed 10,000-vector freeze. Build-mode still needs supported configurations and source sites; resource-envelope needs comparable valid families and measurement controls. The three Std oversize slices cannot be silently replaced or have ceilings raised inside the completed pilot.
